# 🔧 Maintenance

<!--
Title: `docs|test|build|ci|chore(<scope>): summary`, in conventional commits. The squash merge uses it as the commit title.
If this changes what a plugin does on users' machines, use the default template instead.
Never paste secrets, tokens or personal data.
-->

## 📝 Summary
<!-- What and why, 1-2 sentences. -->

Closes # · Related #

## 🏷️ Type
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Tests or evals
- [ ] Dependencies
- [ ] CI / maintainer tooling
- [ ] Chore / cleanup

**Risk:** 🟢 Low (no change to what plugins do). If it is not, switch to the default template.

## 🔍 Changes
-

## ✅ Verification
- [ ] Maintainer checks: `npm run check`, or N/A
- [ ] Changed plugins: `claude plugin validate --strict plugins/<plugin>`, or N/A
- [ ] Docs render correctly, links and examples work, or N/A
- [ ] Dependencies: why, license, release notes read, lockfile regenerated by the tool, or N/A

## 🔒 Safety
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or client-identifying information
- [ ] No internal notes in public-facing content

## 🚦 Before merge
- [ ] I read the whole diff
- [ ] The checks above pass locally, with their output in this PR, and CI checks pass where they run; none skipped, loosened or suppressed
- [ ] Labels applied
